mechanism: Both drugs cause vasodilation and can lower blood pressure; eplerenone is a potassium-sparing diuretic that may elevate potassium levels, and tadalafil potentiates nitric oxide-mediated vasodilation.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and counsel patients on orthostatic hypotension; check serum potassium periodically as tadalafil may worsen hyperkalemia risk from eplerenone.
